entries.title: A recorded wait no longer holds a merge
entries.body: A wait recorded between two tasks holds when the waiting one starts. It no longer stops a merge once that work is under way. A filing that must merge first, a review, and a required action still hold the merge.
entries.noPicture: The change is whether a merge goes through. The activity line is the same shape as any other merge, and no screen shows the hold by itself.
